new_ROOT_corollary_complete_proof: Let r:V(Rhat)->V(R) be the actual normalized boundary homeomorphism of G331n1 at the same extended primary gauge. Every completed proper primary ideal contains a maximal-ideal power, so its finite quotient ideal contracts and extends exactly. Ideal evaluations agree under r, for all supports. Hence r*Q_R=Q_Rhat. Because r is a homeomorphism of compact spaces and pullback is an isometric bijection on continuous real functions, uniform closure gives r*C_R=C_Rhat. Pullback and its inverse preserve actual decreasing nets and their pointwise infima, including bottom, so r*D_R=D_Rhat. G331n8 identifies these completed classes with the independently defined actual-primary-model geometric classes on both excellent rings. This identifies the completed classes, not the raw geometric core or all birational model categories.

For f continuous on V(R), each h in C_R with h<=f corresponds bijectively to hhat=h composed r in C_Rhat with hhat<=f composed r. Taking pointwise suprema gives p_C,Rhat(f composed r)=p_C,R(f) composed r. The same argument works for any envelope defined by pointwise suprema over the actual D classes, with the same convention at bottom. Since r and its inverse send open neighborhoods to open neighborhoods, upper semicontinuous regularization of any such pointwise envelope also commutes with r. Thus membership, pointwise equality of raw and regularized envelopes, and continuity transfer exactly. Every continuous function on the completed boundary is such a pullback, so the assertion that every continuous obstacle has continuous raw envelope is equivalent for R and Rhat.

For the subprobability Jensen set J_x={positive finite Radon mu:mu(V)<=1 and h(x)<=integral h dmu for every h in C_R}, push a measure forward by r inverse. The defining inequality becomes hhat(r inverse x)<=integral hhat d(r inverse_*mu) for every hhat in C_Rhat. This gives exactly Jhat_(r inverse x)=(r inverse)_*J_x. Pushforward and inverse pushforward are homeomorphisms for the weak measure topologies, since they identify all continuous tests on compact Hausdorff spaces. Consequently lower hemicontinuity of these Jensen set-valued maps transfers under completion. No Jensen representation or global lower hemicontinuity theorem is presumed by this naturality argument.
